annotation.title_clean: A Storytelling Robot managing Persuasive and Ethical Stances via ACT-R: an Exploratory Study
annotation.title_en: A Storytelling Robot managing Persuasive and Ethical Stances via ACT-R: an Exploratory Study
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Augello, A.; Città, G.; Gentile, M.; Lieto, A.
annotation.venue: International Journal of Social Robotics (arXiv preprint)
annotation.summary_en: Research paper presenting a storytelling social robot controlled by the ACT-R cognitive architecture. It uses persuasive techniques and ethical stances in COVID-19 conversations. A needs-driven model guides persuasion, evaluated with 63 participants on a simulated robot. It is technical, with no governance instrument.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes a needs-driven ACT-R model selecting persuasive techniques (storytelling, framing, rhetorical arguments).
Integrates ethical stances, e.g. accounting for user conditions like mask allergies.
Exploratory evaluation with 63 participants on a simulated robot.
Claims first persuasive agent integrating cognitive dialogue, storytelling, persuasion and ethics.
